independent_solutions.solver_a:
Step 1: Point charge +Q at center of square base of pyramid.
Step 2: Reflect across base to form closed regular 8-faced octahedron.
Step 3: Total flux through closed octahedron by Gauss's Law is Q / eps_0.
independent_solutions.solver_b:
Step 1: Point charge +Q at center of square base of pyramid.
Step 2: Base flux is zero because field lines lie in base plane.
Step 3: Upper half-space solid angle is 2pi, receiving Q / (2 eps_0).
